sources.2026-11-19-night1: 79 Opus and 106 Sonnet runs of real agent workloads (742 calls, all 5-minute cache writes), analyzed by meter ticks with kit/intervals.py
sources.2026-11-20-night2: Synthetic blocks, one dominant token type each (755 calls), fitted by linear program with kit/fit.py
sources.atlas-2026-10-29: Atlas ADE, Plan usage burn data, model a5v3: https://atlas-ade.dev/docs/plan-usage-burn-data/

notes: Fable rows were measured during the Fable 5.2 launch offer; re-measure after it ends.
Usage reaches the meter when a call ends.
A joint range is never narrower than 3% either side of its point: two intervals of the same Opus mix gave factors 2.3% either side of their mean, and the Sonnet factor rests on one interval.
The directly measured weights landed between 0.53 and 1.79 times the Atlas prior, which is where the unmeasured_factor [0.5, 2.0] comes from.

basis: measured = its own weight was fitted; joint = measured only together with other types in one workload mix (low and high are the range of the shared factor); assumed = a stand-in, low and high are point x unmeasured_factor; published = copied from an outside table.
